24/7 Emergency Contact
Gas: (844) 330-0763 | Electric: (855) 938-3496
 
If you smell gas:
·Leave the area immediately.
 
·From a safe distance, call 911 and report the
situation to CoServ Gas at (844) 330-0763.
 
·Do not return to the area until it is declared safe by
emergency services or CoServ Gas.
